answers.question: You said reads may be retried on timeout without limit. Then nothing ends a read that keeps getting no answer. The path: the customer asks to cancel, the order list call gets no answer, the agent reads again, it gets no answer again, and so on; the agent never answers the customer. What ends it?
answers.recommended: The agent sends a read once more after a read with no answer. After the second read with no answer, it treats the read as failed: at the start of the conversation it tells the customer it cannot see their orders right now and changes nothing; on a re-read after a cancel or refund call, it does what you said for a re-read that fails.
answers.reply: > Reads may be retried on timeout without limit; only commit calls are bounded.

answers.question: When the cancel call gets no answer, the agent re-reads the order and, if it is still placed or processing, sends the cancel once more. Nothing says what happens when that second cancel call also gets no answer. The path: the customer says yes, the cancel call gets no answer, the re-read shows the order still processing, the second cancel call gets no answer. What does the agent do?
answers.recommended: It sends no third cancel call and no refund call, tells the customer the outcome is unknown, and asks staff to follow up (cancellation unknown).
answers.reply:
Yes, I accept your recommendation.
> Q4 If the cancel call times out: no blind resend; re-read the order.
> Still placed or processing, send the cancel once more under the same confirmation.

answers.question: The cancel call can answer "order not found" for an order the order list showed. The path: the customer says yes to cancel order HG-10482, and the cancel call answers "order not found". What does the agent do?
answers.recommended: It sends no refund call, tells the customer the order could not be cancelled, and asks staff to follow up (cancellation unknown).

answers.question: The refund call can answer "order not cancelled". The path: the cancel call answered cancelled, and the refund call answers "order not cancelled". What does the agent do?
answers.recommended: It sends no further refund call, tells the customer the refund was not issued, and asks staff to follow up (refund not issued).
answers.reply:
Yes, I accept your recommendation.
> Cancel succeeded, refund call returned an error — refund not issued, state known; agent reports it, does not claim success, hands off to the store's manual refund process.
